description: This is a shell script used for self-healing connectivity testing on a device. It performs actions such as ping tests, DNS resolution checks, and device reboots based on network health.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay in seconds before starting the ping test.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Triggers a device reboot by simulating a router reset.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Decides if a reset is needed based on process name and triggers reset if required.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs a DNS resolution test and takes corrective action if resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs a network ping test to the default gateway and triggers a reset if ping fails.
